name: Instantly
summary: Cold email outreach platform with a lead database, deliverability tools, AI agents and a CRM.
description: Instantly runs cold email campaigns at scale with deliverability infrastructure such as inbox warm-up, plus a B2B lead database, email verification, website visitor identification, AI sales and reply agents, and a CRM. Managed services are also offered. The pricing page did not render during this check, so no price was recorded. The company also sells done-for-you outreach setup based on its own growth system.

howToUse.title: Open Instantly

howToUse.title: Launch a cold email campaign
howToUse.description: Ask Co-pilot to find leads, write copy, and generate a campaign, then launch that cold email campaign at scale.

howToUse.title: Add deliverability and lead data
howToUse.description: Use the deliverability infrastructure, including inbox warm-up, together with the B2B lead database, email verification, and website visitor identification.
